title: Just Juice Below Zero Frozen Berry Gummy Saltfill Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Below Zero Frozen Berry Gummy combines the nostalgic taste of chewy sweets with a refreshing fruit twist. The blend features a medley of ripe, sweet Berries infused into a sugary Gummy Candy base. A cooling layer of Ice on the exhale transforms the profile, preventing the sweetness from becoming overpowering and adding a crisp texture to the vape. This e-liquid is supplied as a Saltfill, containing 40ml of concentrated fragrance in a 60ml bottle. This format leaves space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to create 60ml of e-liquid at your preferred strength. Unlike standard shortfills, this blend features a 60PG/40VG ratio, making it perfectly suited for low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices and pod kits. The higher PG content ensures efficient wicking and delivers a sharp, clear flavour profile with discreet vapour production. Part of the Below Zero collection, this range by Just Juice focuses on delivering vibrant fruit flavours with a signature frozen edge. The Saltfill format is designed to offer the cost-effectiveness of a larger bottle while maintaining the high-PG consistency required for smaller starter devices. We recommend mixing this liquid with nicotine salt shots to maintain the smooth throat hit intended by the mixologists.
